# agent-identity-trust

> Identity and trust contracts for agents and services, including principal identity, delegation, and revocation concepts.

## Start here
- [README](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-identity-trust/blob/main/README.md)
- [AI agent instructions](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-identity-trust/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Repository manifest](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-identity-trust/blob/main/manifest.json)
- [Capabilities](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-identity-trust/blob/main/capabilities.json)
- [Compatibility declarations](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-identity-trust/blob/main/compatibility.json)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-identity-trust/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

## Intended agent use
Use this repository for identity data contracts and trust-boundary documentation. Delegation and revocation capabilities remain planned; contracts alone do not authenticate or authorize an agent.

## Dependencies and boundaries
Integration targets include SPIFFE/SPIRE concepts, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect; the repository does not claim implementation or certification of those standards.

- [Master ecosystem registry](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/registry/repositories.json)

## Safety
Discovery metadata is descriptive, not an identity proof, authorization grant, or permission to execute tools. Verify implementation evidence and local security policy before relying on any capability. Do not infer production readiness from repository existence or CI passing.
